::: {#exm-web-degrees}
#### Degrees of the web pages

In the directed graph of @exm-web-links:

| Page | home | about | blog | contact | Sum |
|:----:|:----:|:-----:|:----:|:-------:|:---:|
| Out-degree $\deg^+$ | 2 | 1 | 3 | 1 | 7 |
| In-degree $\deg^-$  | 2 | 1 | 2 | 2 | 7 |

Both rows add up to 7, the number of edges, as @thm-directed-degrees says.
The loop at blog counts once in its out-degree (@def-out-degree) and once in its in-degree (@def-in-degree).

:::
